title: Genghis Khan's 5,000-Mile Pony Express
hook: Riders carrying golden passports traveled 200 miles a day switching fresh horses.

scenes.text: To govern an empire that spanned from the Pacific Ocean to Eastern Europe, Genghis Khan created the 'Örtöö' or 'Yam' postal messenger network.

scenes.voicedText: To govern an empire that spanned from the Pacific Ocean to Eastern Europe, Genghis Khan created the 'Örtöö' or 'Yam' postal messenger network.

scenes.text: Stations were positioned every twenty-five miles along empire highways, stocked with fresh steppe horses, food rations, and armed guards.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wooden horse stables on the open steppe with tethered sturdy Mongol ponies feeding on golden hay in mountain sunshine. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Stations were positioned every twenty-five miles along empire highways, stocked with fresh steppe horses, food rations, and armed guards.

scenes.text: Messengers wore bells on their saddles so station staff heard them approaching from miles away and readied a fresh galloping horse.

scenes.text: They wore tight leather bindings around their torsos and heads to withstand the physical trauma of riding two hundred miles in a single day.
